name: ID -Identity-
source:
After a week of suspension, Shuji Akitsuki was back at Ryokuto Academy. 

But it was no longer life as usual. 
There was a distortion to the normality.

In a world gripped by some discomfiting malaise,
can he maintain his individuality, or that of the people
around him?

Clouds have formed.
Strange things are shaking up the town of Sakimicho.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158407.html]DLSite[/url].]
translation:
停学一周后，秋月修二回到了绿斗学园。

但生活已不再如往常。
常态出现了扭曲。

在一个被一些令人不安的不适所困扰的世界里，
他能否保持自己的个性，或者人民的个性
在他周围？

云已经形成。
奇怪的事情正在震动佐见町镇。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE158407.html]DLSite[/url]。]
